role: DOCUMENTARY AUTHORITY / COVERAGE WORKER — SPACE BUNNY

primary_audit.h_b_exact_question: Does every retained HQ125/Dva pressure/counterpressure/mediation use reduce lawfully to already adopted neutral relation, topology and consequence forms? Or is there one exact required meaning that current adopted forms cannot license?

authority_precedence_applied.nine_strata_ontology: SUPERSEDED by adopted Field Forge generalization; retained as requirements evidence and design ancestry only, per E04 §8 and the primary audit
authority_precedence_applied.consequence: the nine stratum LABELS are not required; the retained burden is relational FUNCTION
authority_precedence_applied.scalar_pressure: NOT REQUIRED and actively forbidden; Dva §7 prefers relational/ordinal/unknown/noncomparable states to invented precision
authority_precedence_applied.strong_nouns: BLOCKED_EXPLICIT_AUTHORITY under Field Forge R2 owner/negative ceilings

demands.semantic_content_required: a directed constraint relation from a source position to a receiving position, distinct from opportunity/support
demands.current_adopted_form: V555 atomic route: ordered_structure ordinal 3 RECEIVER carries receiving_constraint_kind (V555-RC-001-EXACT-STRUCTURAL-POSITION-REF). V556 closed objective-world schema role OBJECTIVE_CONSTRAINT. P06 applicable_negative_denial_noncomparability_refs carries exclusion/denial.
demands.positive_rule_authority_required: an active V555 route rule beyond the single V555-RR-001, plus a V556 rule whose content hash commits to a result-contract binding declaring OBJECTIVE_CONSTRAINT

demands.demand: Pressure functioning as provision, opportunity, support or authorization-enabling
demands.exact_terminal_authority: E11 §2 (pressure may function as ... provision ... opportunity ... support)
demands.semantic_content_required: an opportunity-typed relation distinguishable from a constraint-typed relation on the same position pair
demands.current_adopted_form: V556 closed objective-world schema roles OBJECTIVE_OPPORTUNITY and OBJECTIVE_ACTOR_OPPORTUNITY, distinct from OBJECTIVE_CONSTRAINT; Field Forge R2 adopts 'conditional/support/redistribution relations' and 'comparison or directional relations'
demands.positive_rule_authority_required: a V556 rule/result contract/schema declaring OBJECTIVE_OPPORTUNITY
demands.instance_evidence: OBJECTIVE_OPPORTUNITY appears only inside synthetic fixtures in rawlsing_next/tests/test_m3_v556_higher_order_structural.py

demands.demand: Counter-pressure, contradiction and simultaneous or competing pressure relations, without forced averaging
demands.exact_terminal_authority: E11 §1 (pressure / counter-pressure; simultaneous or competing pressure relations); §2 (counter-pressure and contradiction; coexisting pressures without forced averaging)
demands.semantic_content_required: two or more coexisting directed relations over the same or overlapping positions, retained as separate records
demands.current_adopted_form: coexistence as separate V555 routes with SOURCE/RECEIVER exchanged for the counter-relation; V556_INTERACTION_RELATION and V556_TOPOLOGY semantic families hold multiple relations. Field Forge R2 jurisdiction table: 'coexistence of source/channel/receiver refs does not self-mint a route'.

demands.demand: Represent pressure acting downward, upward and laterally, preserving source/driver and receiving/target identities and directionality
demands.exact_terminal_authority: E11 §1 (represent pressure acting downward, upward and laterally among strata; distinguish source/driver stratum, receiving/target stratum, directionality); E11 §13 Q2
demands.semantic_content_required: directionality as first-class structure, plus relative order between positions
demands.current_adopted_form: V555 ordered_structure carries directionality STRUCTURALLY as ordinals 1 SOURCE -> 2 MEDIATION_LOCUS -> 3 RECEIVER under route shape V555-RS-001-SOURCE-EXACT-CHANNEL-EXACT-RECEIVER; it is not an ad hoc scalar or label. OBL041 adopts 'source-native governed order' and 'explicit topology/incidence' as the relative-order carriers.
demands.positive_rule_authority_required: OBL041 governed-order authority at the relevant position pair; more than the single existing V555 route shape
demands.instance_evidence: exactly one V555 route rule/shape/role/constraint-kind tuple is compiled into the module; route_born_predicate_registry ships VALID_EMPTY with registered_predicate_count 0
demands.note: A universal stratum hierarchy is NOT required and would be unlawful: the nine-strata ontology is superseded and OBL041 forbids minting geometry that exact nongeometric relations already suffice for (NO_GEOMETRY_REQUIRED)

demands.demand: Mediation is an essential transformation, not a label: carriers, institutions, frameworks, buffers, cracks, amplification, transmission, deflection, blockage, rerouting, and competing or concurrent pathways; structural mediation POSSIBILITY must stay distinct from actor-specific realized HISTORY
demands.exact_terminal_authority: E11 §3 (essential transformation, not a label; preserve the difference between a structural mediation possibility and an actor-specific realized history); E11 §13 Q4; E04 §12 Gate F5
demands.semantic_content_required: a governed mediation locus between source and receiver with an explicit channel role, plus a possibility/realization separation

demands.positive_rule_authority_required: additional V555 route rules; SDTF R4 mechanism rule authority bindings per class
demands.instance_scope_ceiling: frozen GT2 canary only; context only; explicitly carries NO pressure/hegemony/capital semantics

demands.semantic_content_required: a governed joint representation of coexisting relations preserving nonadditivity, with no invented scalar
demands.current_adopted_form: V556_INTERACTION_RELATION and V556_TOPOLOGY semantic families in m3_v556_higher_order_structural.py; separate records preserve nonadditivity by construction; Dva §7 forbids numeric edge weight absent a governed formula
demands.positive_rule_authority_required: an active V556 rule of semantic family V556_INTERACTION_RELATION or V556_TOPOLOGY with a bound result contract
demands.note: The primary audit already held that V556 rule/result forms can express interactions and that no universal scalar coupling law is required; nothing found here contradicts that

demands.exact_terminal_authority: E11 §7 (typed, provenance-bearing topology of possible pressure flow rather than a list of generic route labels); E11 §13 Q7

demands.positive_rule_authority_required: an active V556_TOPOLOGY rule with a bound schema declaring endpoint and route-identity fields

demands.demand: Occurrence versus consequence must remain distinct; pressure structurally present but not actor-realized must be distinguishable from realized occurrence

demands.semantic_content_required: a typed separation between constitutive/positional status, qualified possibility, realized occurrence and active durative state
demands.current_adopted_form: SDTF R4 consequence classes in sdtf_r4_witness_currentness.py: K1_CONSTITUTIVE_POSITIONAL, K2_QUALIFIED_POSSIBILITY, K3_REALIZED_OCCURRENCE, K4_ACTIVE_DURATIVE
demands.positive_rule_authority_required: an SDTF R4 witness-currentness rule instance per consequence class

demands.exact_terminal_authority: E11 §1 (temporal persistence, drift, rupture, absence and noncomparability); E11 §2 (downstream use blocked, uncertain, absent or noncomparable); E11 §13 Q3; E04 §10 cross-wave temporal pressure; E04 §12 Gate F7

demands.current_adopted_form: SDTF K4_ACTIVE_DURATIVE (continuation), K3_REALIZED_OCCURRENCE (rupture/occurrence); V556 M3DecisionState NONCOMPARABLE, UNKNOWN_AUTHORITY, CONFLICTING_AUTHORITY, VALID_EMPTY; OBL040 typed states NO_GEOMETRY_REQUIRED, NONCOMPARABLE, NO_TRANSPORT, OBSERVABILITY_LIMIT, VALID_EMPTY, MISSING_AUTHORITY; P06 applicable_negative_denial_noncomparability_refs; Field Forge R2 V553 jurisdiction: FIELD FORGE may supply anchors/relations/limits but may not invent change, drift, rupture or continuity

demands.noncollapse: E04 §10 freezes TWO_WAVES_EXIST != TEMPORAL_DIRECTIONALITY_AUTHORITY and SINGLE_WAVE_PRESSURE != TEMPORAL_PRESSURE_FIELD, so drift/rupture is never inferable from wave count alone

demands.demand: Represent structural contradiction, alignment and divergence
demands.exact_terminal_authority: E04 §10 (the current PRE-V3 world must be capable of representing temporal movement in ... contradiction / alignment / divergence)
demands.semantic_content_required: a verdict relation over two structural relations, requiring comparability authority to be non-vacuous
demands.current_adopted_form: V556 higher-order object: the result schema is externally bound per rule and constrained to the closed role vocabulary, so a schema may declare relation exact_refs plus an OBJECTIVE_STATUS string enum carrying ALIGNED / CONTRADICTORY / DIVERGENT / NONCOMPARABLE; V556_INTERACTION_RELATION family carries the relation-over-relation step
demands.positive_rule_authority_required: a V556 rule plus result-contract binding plus closed schema declaring two relation refs and the divergence verdict enum, AND exact comparability authority per E04 §10
demands.note: V555 alone cannot bind a relation as source or receiver: its endpoint bindings are F1 structural POSITION refs. This is a jurisdiction split resolved by V556, not a missing meaning.

demands.finding: The phrase 'comparative pressure' occurs exactly once in the entire repository at startup: in the HQ203 commission that asks the question. No terminal authority demands comparative pressure. Cross-source comparability is affirmatively gated: E04 §9 freezes CROSS_SOURCE_COMPOSITION != CROSS_SOURCE_JOINT_RESPONDENT_CLAIM, and OBL040 freezes MISSING_OBSERVABILITY != OBSERVED_ZERO. Classified NOT_A_RETAINED_DEMAND.

demands.demand: A single undifferentiated scalar structural-pressure magnitude
demands.current_adopted_form: no scalar form is adopted, and that absence is compliance rather than a gap
demands.positive_rule_authority_required: none; minting one would need a governed formula
demands.finding: Dva §7 freezes that no numeric edge weight is required unless a governed formula gives it a lawful interpretation, and that relational, ordinal, unknown and noncomparable states are preferable to invented precision. OBL041 freezes BLOCK_SIZE != WEIGHT != PREVALENCE != SPATIAL_EXTENT != IMPORTANCE. OBL040 freezes MISSING_MAP != ZERO_DISTANCE. Production already asserts CONDITIONAL_SUPPORT_PROFILE != PRESSURE_PATHWAY. Classified NOT_A_RETAINED_DEMAND_AND_CURRENTLY_FORBIDDEN.
